name: hourwise
description: Repo-level scripts: lint/format, tests, local database and backups. No dependencies.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --all-targets && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: node scripts/cargo.mjs fmt --check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm backend hourwise-backend migrate
scripts.db:verify: docker compose run --rm backend hourwise-backend verify
